name: aeroserver
description: AeroCore OTA update server: signed manifests for a GCS/AIR fleet, plus an admin UI for publishing releases

scripts.test:unit: npm run check && node --test tests/tar.test.js tests/bundle.test.js tests/version.test.js tests/manifest.test.js tests/jwt.test.js tests/range.test.js tests/errors.test.js
scripts.test:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://aeroserver:aeroserver@127.0.0.1:55432/aeroserver_test npm test; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down
scripts.dev:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f --tail=40 aeroserver
scripts.dev:reload: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart aeroserver
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f --tail=100 aeroserver
scripts.dev:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U aeroserver -d aeroserver
